mcp_plugin_description: Lets agents use the tools and resources of MCP servers: programs on this computer and remote servers. You approve each call unless a permission or full access covers it.
mcp_start_failed_storage: The MCP plugin could not read its servers. Restart Mannie, then turn the plugin on again.
mcp_start_failed_http: The MCP plugin could not set up its secure connections. Restart Mannie, then turn the plugin on again.

match.countPlural=one: A call of an MCP tool is running. Turning MCP off ends it, and whether it took effect is unknown.
match.countPlural=other: {count} calls of MCP tools are running. Turning MCP off ends them, and whether they took effect is unknown.

mcp_settings_description: Servers of the Model Context Protocol whose tools and resources agents use. Mannie keeps their secrets in your system's credential store.
mcp_list_failed_title: The MCP servers could not be loaded
mcp_empty_description: Add a program that runs on this computer, such as npx with a server's package, or the URL of a remote server. Agents can then use its tools, and you approve each call.
mcp_signing_in: Continue in your browser at {host}. Mannie waits five minutes for the sign-in.
mcp_sign_in_oauth_off: This server asks for a sign-in. Edit it and turn on Sign in with OAuth.
mcp_missing_secrets: Enter the values of {names} to use this server.
mcp_warning_token_in_argument: Argument {number} looks like a token. Approvals and the journal show arguments, so keep it in a secret variable instead.

match.countPlural=one: The server added a tool, which is off until you turn it on.
match.countPlural=other: The server added {count} tools, which are off until you turn them on.

match.countPlural=one: A tool of this server cannot be offered to agents. Show tools says why.
match.countPlural=other: {count} tools of this server cannot be offered to agents. Show tools says why.

mcp_failure_program_not_found: The program was not found. Enter its full path, or a name on Mannie's PATH.
mcp_failure_program_refused: Mannie does not start this file as a server, such as a script of another kind or a program in Mannie's own folders.
mcp_failure_working_directory_invalid: The working folder does not exist.
mcp_failure_argument_refused: An argument cannot be given to the program, such as one that the Windows command interpreter would read as code.
mcp_failure_variable_refused: The variable {name} cannot be given to the server.
mcp_failure_too_many_servers: {limit} local servers run already, the most for the plugin. Turn one off first.
mcp_failure_spawn_failed: The program could not be started. Show log may say why.
mcp_failure_exited: The program ended before it answered, with exit code {code}. Show log may say why.
mcp_failure_exited_without_code: The program ended before it answered. Show log may say why.
mcp_failure_crashed: The server stopped {restarts} times in five minutes, so Mannie stopped starting it. Restart it once the problem is fixed.
mcp_failure_timed_out: The server did not answer within {seconds} seconds.
mcp_failure_unreachable: The server could not be reached. Check its address, and that it runs.
mcp_failure_http_status: The server answered with the HTTP status {status}.
mcp_failure_protocol: The server does not speak MCP as Mannie does.
mcp_failure_sse_only: The server speaks only HTTP with server-sent events, which Mannie does not speak.
mcp_failure_secret_missing: A secret of the server is not stored. Edit the server and enter it.
mcp_failure_credential_store_unavailable: Mannie could not use your system's credential store. Check that it is available, then restart the server.
mcp_failure_authorization_unsupported: The authorization server does not offer what a sign-in needs, such as PKCE with S256.
mcp_failure_sign_in_failed: The sign-in failed. Try again, and check Show log.
mcp_error_name_taken: Another server has this name. Choose another name.
mcp_error_prefix_taken: Another server has this prefix. Choose another prefix.
mcp_error_server_not_found: The server is no longer registered.
mcp_error_transport_changed: A server keeps its kind. Add a new server for another kind.
mcp_error_tool_not_found: The server no longer lists this tool.
mcp_error_too_many_tools: At most {limit} tools of all servers can be on. Turn another tool off first.
mcp_error_configuration_too_large: The configuration is too long. Paste only the servers to add.
mcp_error_configuration_not_json: The configuration is not valid JSON.
mcp_error_configuration_empty: The configuration lists no servers under mcpServers or servers.
mcp_error_configuration_too_many_servers: The configuration lists more than 32 servers. Paste fewer at a time.
mcp_error_program_not_found: The program was not found. Enter its full path, or a name on Mannie's PATH.
mcp_error_program_refused: Mannie does not start this file as a server.
mcp_error_no_sign_in: This server does not sign in with OAuth.
mcp_error_authorization_failed: The authorization server could not be reached or refused the sign-in. Try again later.
mcp_error_authorization_unsupported: The authorization server does not offer what a sign-in needs, such as PKCE with S256.
mcp_error_client_id_needed: The authorization server does not register Mannie on its own. Register a client there, then enter its client ID in the server's settings.
mcp_error_credential_store_unavailable: Mannie could not use your system's credential store. Check that it is available, then try again.
mcp_error_storage_failed: Mannie could not save the change. Try again.
mcp_server_dialog_description: Mannie keeps secret variables and headers in your system's credential store, and sends them only to this server.
mcp_field_name_description: How you and the agents call the server. Approvals show it.
mcp_field_prefix_description: The start of its tools' names after mcp_, such as github in mcp_github_create_issue: up to 16 lower-case letters and digits, starting with a letter. Leave it empty to take one from the name.
mcp_field_program_description: A full path, or a name on Mannie's PATH such as npx or uvx. Mannie starts it with your rights.
mcp_located_in_project: This program lies inside one of your projects, where an agent's changes could replace it.
mcp_field_arguments_description: One argument on each line, exactly as the program receives it.
mcp_field_folder_description: A full path. Leave it empty for your home folder.
mcp_field_url_description: The server's Streamable HTTP endpoint over https. Plain http reaches only this computer and private networks.
mcp_field_variables_description: Plain variables of the server's environment. A name that looks like a secret's, such as GITHUB_TOKEN, belongs among the secret variables.
mcp_field_secret_variables_description: Their values reach only this server's environment, and the settings never show them again.
mcp_field_headers_description: Plain headers of the server's requests. A header that carries a credential, such as Authorization, belongs among the secret headers.
mcp_field_secret_headers_description: Their values reach only this server's URL, and the settings never show them again.
mcp_secret_stored: Stored. Leave it empty to keep it.
mcp_secret_moved: {name} looks like a secret, so it moved to the secrets.
mcp_field_oauth_description: The server sends you to its authorization server in your browser, and Mannie keeps the tokens in your system's credential store.
mcp_field_client_id_description: A client that you registered with the authorization server. Leave it empty to let the authorization server register Mannie.
mcp_field_client_secret_description: Only for a client that has one.
mcp_field_client_secret_keep: Leave it empty to keep the stored one.
mcp_field_images_description: Images that the server's tools return reach the model, without their metadata. A model that cannot read images fails the reply.
mcp_field_instructions: Give the server's instructions to the model
mcp_field_instructions_description: What the server says about using it, up to 2,000 characters, marked as the server's words.
mcp_field_timeout_description: Seconds before a call of the server's tool ends: from {min} to {max}.
mcp_invalid_name: Enter a name of up to 64 characters, without control characters or white space at its ends.
mcp_invalid_prefix: Enter up to 16 lower-case letters and digits that start with a letter, other than read, or leave the prefix empty.
mcp_invalid_program: Enter a program of up to 1,024 characters.
mcp_invalid_arguments: Enter at most 64 arguments of at most 4,096 bytes each.
mcp_invalid_folder: Enter a full path, or leave the folder empty.
mcp_invalid_url: Enter an https URL without a user, a password, a fragment or a secret in its query. Plain http reaches only this computer and private networks.
mcp_invalid_plain: Check the names and values: each name once, without a name that looks like a secret's.
mcp_invalid_secrets: Check the secrets: each name once, a value without line breaks, and no Authorization header beside OAuth.
mcp_invalid_oauth: Only a remote server signs in with OAuth.
mcp_invalid_client_id: Enter a client ID of visible characters, with OAuth on.
mcp_invalid_client_secret: Enter a client secret of visible characters, with a client ID.
mcp_invalid_timeout: Enter a timeout from 10 to 3,600 seconds.
mcp_tools_description: Agents get the tools that are on. What the server says of a tool is its own claim, and decides nothing.
mcp_tools_failed_title: The tools could not be loaded
mcp_hint_destructive: Says it may delete or overwrite
mcp_hint_idempotent: Says a repeat changes nothing more
mcp_hint_open_world: Says it reaches beyond the server
mcp_problem_schema_invalid: Agents cannot use it: its schema is not an object schema, or it is too large.
mcp_problem_activity_clash: Agents cannot use it: its schema names both activity and activity_value.
mcp_problem_too_long: Agents cannot use it: its description or its schema is too long.
mcp_log_description: The server's error output and what happened to its connections, with its secrets replaced. Mannie keeps it in memory until it quits.
mcp_log_failed_title: The log could not be loaded
mcp_event_exited: The program ended with exit code {code}
mcp_remove_description: Mannie stops the server, deletes its secrets and tokens, and forgets it and its tools. Permissions for its tools stay in the Tools settings until you revoke them, and cover nothing without the server.
mcp_paste_description: Paste the JSON of another client's servers, under mcpServers or servers. Mannie reads it without running anything.
mcp_paste_failed_title: The configuration could not be read
mcp_paste_missing: You enter {names} after adding it, and it stays off until then.
mcp_paste_disabled: The configuration turns it off, so it starts off.
mcp_refusal_sse_only: It speaks only HTTP with server-sent events, which Mannie does not speak.
mcp_refusal_no_endpoint: It names neither a program nor a URL.
mcp_refusal_invalid_program: Its program, arguments or folder break the rules of servers.
mcp_refusal_invalid_url: Its URL is not https, or carries a credential.
mcp_refusal_invalid_value: A variable's or a header's name or value breaks their rules.
mcp_refusal_invalid_name: Its name is not one that a server may have.
mcp_refusal_name_taken: A server of this name is registered already.
mcp_mention_summary_resource: The agent got the resource's content
mcp_mention_resource_not_found: No connected server lists this resource now.
mcp_mention_read_failed: The server did not give the resource.
mcp_tool_failure_not_called: The call did not reach the server.
mcp_tool_failure_timed_out: The server did not answer in time, and whether the call took effect is unknown.
mcp_tool_failure_server_stopped: The server stopped during the call, and whether the call took effect is unknown.
mcp_tool_failure_input_required: The server asked for input that Mannie does not give servers.
mcp_tool_failure_task_started: The server started a task of its own, which Mannie does not follow.
mcp_sign_in_page_signed_in: You are signed in. You can close this page and return to Mannie.
mcp_sign_in_page_failed: The sign-in failed. Return to Mannie and try again.
